static_gates.name: Soak
static_gates.requirement: 60 min at a stable rate: gates hold, CK1–CK6 pass, no upward trend in RSS, Gen 2 GC/s, ThreadPool queue, pool wait
static_gates.evidence: At 250 req/s (125 completed payments/s) for 60 min (900,604 arrivals, 453,183 payments), on the D57 config and D58 build: p99 28.60 ms, 5-minute p99 19–33 ms including the 30-minute checkpoint, 0 errors, CK1–CK6, CK9, CK10 pass. RSS flat at 172–179 MB after warm-up; Gen 2 GC, ThreadPool queue and pool wait 0 throughout. The run is invalid only because k6 dropped 22 of ~900,000 arrivals with 0.8 s of VU headroom (fixed in `3f56a33`); the owner ruled the generator failed and the payment system passed, and defers the rerun to Stage 2. At 500 req/s both 60-min soaks failed p99 (589.57 ms, 298.14 ms) on WAL commit stalls on the shared virtual disk.
